integrity: Stationary renewal and algebraic proof, with independent rational raw-moment checker; numeric root values are illustrative only.
scientific_limitations: One-time stationary fourth cumulant; independent Gaussian complete Poisson resets in a 1D harmonic trap only; zero cumulant does not imply Gaussian law; no non-Poisson extension.
title: Two reentrant kurtosis regimes under Gaussian-distributed Ornstein–Uhlenbeck resets
